description:
About Kiddom

Kiddom is transforming K–12 education by bringing high-quality curriculum, instructional tools, and student analytics together in one coherent system. We are building Learning Intelligence Technology (LIT), a new category that gives educators the infrastructure to plan, teach, assess, and respond to student needs. With Kiddom, educators spend less time managing administrative burden and more time delivering meaningful student instruction. Kiddom helps schools and districts deliver more equitable, effective, and adaptive learning experiences.

Role summary

The Editorial QA Lead Contractor is responsible for high-quality curriculum experiences, instructional design, content quality, standards alignment, and educator impact. This role partners across teams to deliver high-quality work, create clarity, and improve outcomes for customers, employees, and the business. Leads teams of contractors to ensure print pages are high quality and completed on-time, error free.

Key responsibilities

  • Create, review, and improve curriculum materials, learning experiences, and instructional resources.

  • Collaborate with product, design, learning, and customer-facing teams to align content with educator and learner needs.

  • Maintain quality, accuracy, accessibility, and consistency across curriculum deliverables.

  • Lead a team of editorial contractors to oversee timelines, the quality assurance process is done correctly, validate the work of the team, work with vendors to answer queries.

Required qualifications

  • 4+ years of relevant experience or equivalent practical background.

  • Strong ownership, organization, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Experience developing instructional, curriculum, learning, or education-focused content.

  • Portfolio or work samples demonstrating strong design judgment, craft, and iteration.

  • Has experience leading teams of editors

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working in a high-growth, cross-functional environment.

  • Comfort using data, documentation, and structured communication to drive decisions.

  • Interest in education technology, school systems, and improving outcomes for educators and learners.

Success measures

  • Delivers work on time with clear ownership, quality, and measurable impact.

  • Builds strong working relationships with stakeholders and cross-functional partners.

  • Improves processes, documentation, quality, and decision-making within the role’s scope.

Rate: $31 per hour

What we offer

  • Full time permanent employees are eligible for the following benefits from their first day of employment:

  • Competitive salary

  • Meaningful equity

  • Health insurance benefits: medical (various PPO/HMO/HSA plans), dental, vision, disability and life insurance

  • 401k plan

  • One Medical membership (in participating locations)

  • Flexible vacation time policy (subject to internal approval). Average use 4 weeks off per year.

  • 10 paid sick days per year (pro rated depending on start date)

  • Paid holidays

  • Paid bereavement leave

  • Paid family leave after birth/adoption. Minimum of 16 paid weeks for birthing parents, 10 weeks for caretaker parents. Meant to supplement benefits offered by State.

  • Commuter and FSA plans


Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

Kiddom is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, color, gender, sexual orientation, transgender status, national origin, citizenship status, uniform service member status, pregnancy, age, genetic information, disability, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.
